ROADMAP § Phase 2 goal (verbatim, not in user-story format; no user story is invented): "Documentation matches deployed reality and the small outstanding operational verification chores close out."

<objective>
Stop shipping browser sourcemaps: let the Sentry SDK generate, upload and then delete them, document the config on /docs/infrastructure, record the #502 gate, land it so the stripped build reaches staging, and measure that image against v0.97.2.

D-15 step (1), the staging event, is plan 02-09; it needs this build on staging with the DSN from plan 02-14.
Output: one merged PR, the staging upload gate passed, `02-SOURCEMAP-MEASUREMENT.md` with a verdict, the D-32 issue.
</objective>

**Sentry 11.10.0 (RESEARCH § HOUSE-03 facts, read from the packed sources).** A user-set `productionBrowserSourceMaps` makes the SDK stand down (`withSentryConfig/getFinalConfigObjectBundlerUtils.js:127-129`); with the key unset and the wrapper active, the SDK enables browser maps itself and defaults the delete to true (`:134-146`); the option is `sourcemaps.deleteSourcemapsAfterUpload` (`types.d.ts:406`). Keep the explicit option although it equals the default: it states the intent in place (D-14). An upload error is logged and the build continues; the maps are deleted anyway (`build-plugin-manager.js:476`, `handleRunAfterProductionCompile.js:43-57`). The only per-leg proof of an upload is the log line `Successfully uploaded source maps to Sentry` (`build-plugin-manager.js:395`), and GlitchTip answers before it assembles, so even that line does not prove storage (Pitfall 2): D-15 (1) does. `next.config.mjs` has no `turbopack` key, so Sentry injects the debug IDs itself.

**Baseline (RESEARCH, measured 2026-11-14, v0.97.2 amd64, digest `sha256:c5534747…`).** 142 static `.map` files, 31,057,870 bytes; 48 server `.map` files, 6,672 bytes; 135 static `.js` files, 7,264,852 bytes; `docker image inspect .Size` prints 0 under this daemon's containerd store, so measure by export. The runtime image is `node:26-slim`, WORKDIR `/app`.

**Land (D-22, D-27).** Note under `## Unreleased`, no version bump. `npm run lint:fix`; verify chain; `git fetch -q origin && git rebase origin/develop`; `git push -u origin HEAD`; `gh pr create --base develop --fill`; `gh pr checks <n> --watch --required`; `gh pr merge <n> --rebase`; `gh pr view <n> --json state --jq .state` prints `MERGED`; then `git push origin --delete chore/house-03-sourcemaps`; remove the lane from the GSD working tree.

|----------|-------------|

| public site → visitors | After the strip, browser maps are no longer served |
| issue text → public | The #502 comment and the D-32 issue are public |
